CustomField.inlineHelpText: CONTENT IDENTITY, NOT DOCUMENTATION. Required when Row Customizer Flow is set. Any value - only whether it CHANGED matters. Hashed into the quote fingerprint, so bumping it is what makes quotes regenerate after you edit the Flow. Editing a Flow leaves its API name unchanged and is invisible to the fingerprint, so if you do not bump this, quotes stay Ready and reuse a snapshot your edited Flow would never have produced. Bump it whenever you activate a new Flow version.
CustomField.label: Row Customizer Flow Version
